task_name: Define attachment response hydration and realtime contract

concerns_addressed: PHASE-002 is resolved by correction commit b132fb6e809481f25d189c5967918fb573394b22: server attachment realtime events now use the client-compatible nested metadata-only payload shape, with competing top-level attachment fields removed.

strengths: server/src/realtime.ts defines a narrow AttachmentEventPayload containing exactly attachmentId, mimeType, and createdAt, and requires it for both attachment.added and attachment.removed.
The discriminated BoardEvent union removes top-level attachmentId and attachment fields; the @ts-expect-error compile guard rejects both legacy fields while the nested payload remains accepted.
The local fan-out round-trip test verifies the metadata-only payload is delivered without bytes or storage paths, and the server realtime suite passes all 16 tests.

All existing BoardEvent type literals remain present, including workspace, agent, tracker, and focus events; the client attachment contract test passes and repository server/client typechecks are green.
Correction commit b132fb6 changes only server/src/realtime.ts and server/src/realtime.test.ts; client production code, tracker/routes, and log.json are unchanged.

issues.description: The prior T4 correction integration test still has two formatter suggestions for line wrapping, so that correction file is not fully Biome-formatted even though its focused test and typecheck pass.
